title: Pairing
summary: How a new device joins a collection.

requirements.text: A new device joins by scanning a pairing QR code, which works for one device and for `tandem.pairing-lifetime`.
Either device can show the pairing code: a phone scans it with its camera, a computer with its webcam, and either can paste it instead.
A device that already holds data can still join, once the user agrees after giving it the code; a complete copy of its database is saved first, then the collection replaces it.
